user.title: Connect to HikConnect
user.description: Sign in with the account you use in the Niko Access Control app.

data_description.username: The account you use in the Niko Access Control app.

device.title: Choose your doorbell
device.description: These doorbells are linked to your account.

manual.title: Enter the serial number
manual.description: The doorbell list could not be loaded from your account. Enter the serial number instead.

data_description.device_serial: In the Niko Access Control app: Menu → Info → System information → Product number.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password for doorbell {serial} no longer works. Enter your current Niko Access Control account details.

reconfigure.title: Change account
reconfigure.description: Update the Niko Access Control account used for doorbell {serial}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to HikConnect. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check your username and password.
error.device_not_found: This serial number is not linked to the account. Check the product number in the Niko Access Control app.

abort.no_new_devices: All doorbells on this account are already set up.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Send a push notification with the snapshot to Home Assistant Companion app devices each time someone rings. {count} mobile devices found. Tapping the notification opens the call history. After saving, use “Send test notification” in this menu or the Test notification button on the device page.

data_description.notify_message: Use {time} for the time of the ring and {date} for the date. Both follow the language and country in Settings → System → General.
data_description.notify_time_sensitive: Break through Focus / Do Not Disturb on iPhone and use high priority on Android.

local.title: Local device access (two-way audio)
local.description: Optional. Needed for the Announce action, which plays speech through the doorbell speaker over your local network. Leave the IP address and password empty to disable.

data_description.local_host: The doorbell's address on your network, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.local_username: The local admin account of the doorbell (usually admin).

error.cannot_connect_local: Could not connect to the doorbell at the given IP. Check the IP address and credentials.
error.incomplete_local: Fill in the IP address, username and password, or clear the IP address and password to disable local access.
error.no_devices_selected: Select at least one device, or choose “All mobile devices”.
error.no_mobile_devices: No Home Assistant Companion app devices found. Install the app on a phone and sign in first.
error.invalid_message: The message contains an unknown placeholder. Use {time} and {date} only.

abort.test_sent: Test notification sent to {count} device(s), using the last call.
abort.test_failed: The test notification could not be sent to: {failed}. Check the logs.
abort.notifications_off: Notifications are off. Turn them on under Notifications first.
abort.no_mobile_devices: No Home Assistant Companion app devices to notify. Check the notification settings.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Try again in a moment.
